limits: Repeated local x86-64 WSL measurements; no cold loader/page-cache, physical target, worst-case latency or universal performance claim.
Timed prepare/commit includes dlopen, migration and two registrations; old callbacks are not queued in the timing cells. Separate deterministic real-thread tests hold a plugin callback across commit.
Logical state bytes exclude allocator row rounding, registry/control objects, module mappings, worker stacks, pthread/libdl internals and OS resources.
Failure gate is a pre-close retention model. No invalid handle or forced OS loader failure is used.
Serialized controller calls; no forceful cancellation of an executing callback.
